scenes.summary: You've taken some weight off Qin Jiangchi's shoulders, but her duty roster stays crimson. Rebuilding after catastrophe takes years, and you'll be sharing every battle ahead.

lines.text: Endmin, we really appreciate your work. Plenty of people in the Hub Base are talking about all the help you've provided.
Regardless, my workload and stress dropped a lot... Thank you, and I mean it.
Anyway, please take care of your health, Endmin. Your well-being matters—
Director Qin, the UWST representative is here for the meeting about the outpost project.
At least take this from us. A token of gratitude from everyone in this base.
And just so you know, everyone's hoping to organize that welcoming ceremony. It may have to be delayed, but we'll do it when everyone has time... Now, if you'd excuse me.
You might consider your help insignificant. But in fact, it took a lot of weight off her shoulders.
For decades, Valley IV has weathered and survived one crisis after another. The people of the Valley have proven themselves to be incredibly resilient.
What they need is simple: just a friendly and helpful hand after a fall.
You've already done your best. Now all that's left is to trust everyone. We have always relied on each other, and that is exactly how we've made it to this day.
Oh...? Of course, Endmin. I'm always here.
Let's continue our work. The Hub Base will definitely endure these difficult times.

options: It proves everyone's hard at work as well.
We face challenges together. I'm glad I was able to help.
Well, please also take care of your health, Director.
Sounds like it's been put on an indefinite hold.
I didn't really share much of her workload...
So, can I rely on you?
